symptom: Sidebar shows '[!] Tesseract not found. OCR fallback disabled.' even though the app uses Surya OCR, not Tesseract. Confuses contributors.
rootcause: app.py:58-61 checks for the tesseract binary via shutil.which() and shows a warning, but the codebase migrated from Tesseract to Surya OCR. The check was never removed.
fix: Remove the _check_tesseract() function and _tesseract_ok flag from app.py. Remove the sidebar warning block that references it.
